items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: His name was Professor Parson. He started us out.

ctx.x: My birthday is the 4th of September. And, in 1921, it was a guy got a band together, a school band, and we started playing like that. His name was Professor Parson. He started us out. We got the band, he started us out in school playing. So I first started playing E-flat clarinet.
What school was that? Do you know the name of the school?
